display.crosshair_overlay: HTML/CSS only; not burned into raw registered images
display.stretch: independent linear 0.5 to 99.5 percentile per image

purpose: Create a display-only registered raw-image blink for Pair-17 candidates 293118 and 293841, comparing the Hamburg science plate with the Hamburg close-time plate about 1.03 h later. The goal is to inspect the same sky coordinate across the two physical plates without changing candidate state or performing new source detection.

registration.center_coordinate: frozen v075 Hamburg endpoint RA/Dec for each candidate
registration.common_grid_projection: ICRS sky-offset grid centered on frozen v075 Hamburg endpoint coordinate
registration.display_pixel_scale: coarser of the two local WCS pixel scales, derived per candidate
